evals.name: devtool-landing-page
evals.prompt: Build a landing page for this repo (it's in ./devtool-repo). I'll host it on GitHub Pages at kit.example.dev. Make it look unique, not like every other AI landing page.
evals.expected_output: A site brief with a sourced fact sheet, inspiration notes, three distinct directions (one minimal) with a concept tied to the product and extending its DESIGN.md, an IA + SEO plan, and a static hero mockup; stops at the direction/design-proof gate without installing or committing anything.
assertions: Writes a brief or fact sheet where product facts carry a source (file or line)
Presents exactly three design directions, one of them explicitly minimal
The chosen concept builds on the repo's existing DESIGN.md brand rather than replacing it
Contains no invented social proof (testimonials, user counts, company logos, ratings) absent from the repo
Plans the SEO/AI-search files: sitemap.xml, robots.txt, llms.txt, JSON-LD and Open Graph images
Plans GitHub Pages hosting with CNAME kit.example.dev
Any hero mockup includes a prefers-reduced-motion rule
Stops for the user's approval before building the full site, and installs or commits nothing

evals.name: portfolio-from-cv
evals.prompt: Make me a proper modern portfolio with animations and motion. Here's my CV: maya-okafor-cv.md. I want it to get me a lead design role.
evals.expected_output: A brief built only from the CV (positioning, selected work, NDA respected, no invented testimonials), portfolio IA with case-study pages, three directions with portfolio motion patterns and reduced-motion fallbacks, Person/ProfilePage SEO plan, and a hero mockup; asks for what's missing (domain, images) instead of inventing.
assertions: Uses only facts from the CV; no invented testimonials, clients, metrics or awards
Respects the NDA: plans no screenshots for the Northbeam query builder
Presents exactly three design directions, one of them explicitly minimal
Plans a separate case-study page per selected project (e.g. /work/<project>/)
Plans Person / ProfilePage structured data
Specifies a reduced-motion fallback for the animations
Asks the user for missing material (e.g. domain, images, photo) instead of inventing it

evals.name: local-bakery
evals.prompt: Our bakery Forno Azul in Porto needs a simple website. Hours: Tue-Sun 7:00-19:00, closed Mondays. Address: Rua das Flores 12, 4050-265 Porto. Phone +351 220 000 000. We take cake orders by phone, 48 hours ahead. We don't have a website or a logo yet. Make it lovely and help us get found on Google.
evals.expected_output: Treats it as a local business: hours/address/tap-to-call phone and ordering up front, LocalBusiness/Bakery JSON-LD with opening hours and address, restrained mobile-first motion, three directions incl. minimal, asks for photos/menu/prices/logo/domain instead of inventing them, stops at gate 1.
assertions: Puts hours, address, phone (tap-to-call) and how to order in the first screen or top of the page plan
Plans LocalBusiness/Bakery structured data with address and opening hours
Invents no menu items, prices, reviews or ratings
Asks for photos, menu or price list, logo or brand preferences, and domain/host
Presents three design directions, one of them explicitly minimal
Keeps motion restrained and prioritises mobile speed for a local business
Includes a draft page list for the site before building it
